subject: Re: SolidData LLM pilot — scheduling and next steps
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Roth <evan.roth@soliddata.io>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <pkapoor@soliddata.io>
Date: 2026-09-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: SolidData LLM pilot — quick sync and demo confirmation

Hi Evan / Priya,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — great to hear more about the customer support use case and token-volume expectations. Per our call I booked a 45-minute product demo for Tues Sep 28 at 10am PT to walk through a focused proof-of-concept workflow (ingest -> embeddings -> contextual generation) and discuss performance/cost tradeoffs.

Agenda (45 min):
- 10 min: recap of use case & success criteria
- 20 min: live demo with a sample ticket flow
- 10 min: deployment options & next steps (Dedicated vs Private)

I attached the platform migration timeline you mentioned (from your notes) so we can align later. If that slot doesn't work, tell me a couple windows next week and I’ll update.

Attaching: calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics)

Look forward to it — we’ll keep it light and technical.

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0173

---
Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (text/calendar)

From: Evan Roth <evan.roth@soliddata.io>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <pkapoor@soliddata.io>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SolidData LLM pilot — quick sync and demo confirmation

Hi Dev,

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. Quick heads-up: our engineering org just kicked off a cross-team platform migration next week that pulls our backend and infra leads (including the folks we'd want in the demo) onto a multi-week migration sprint. On top of that, our head of product is traveling for the next two weeks and isn’t available to sign off on any new pilot commitments right now.

Given that, we’re going to deprioritize the LLM pilot and push it into the backlog for now. We still think the use case is promising, but timing is bad — the migration is a hard dependency for the integrations we looked at.

Can we park the demo and check back in January? If it helps, I attached a short PNG of the migration milestones so you can see why the timing is tight.

Apologies for the change — please let me know if you want a quick call to talk through feasibility or if your team has a lightweight evaluation we could run without the full infra crew.

Best,
Evan Roth
VP, Engineering (Platform)
SolidData
evan.roth@soliddata.io

---
Attachment: SolidData-Platform-Migration-Timeline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Roth <evan.roth@soliddata.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Priya Kapoor <pkapoor@soliddata.io>
Date: 2026-09-20T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SolidData LLM pilot — quick sync and demo confirmation

Evan — thanks for the update and the timeline PDF (appreciate the context). Totally understand the migration pull and travel constraints.

Quick proposal from our side to make this low-effort for you while keeping the opportunity warm:
- Park the full demo for now and set a gentle calendar check-in for early Jan (I can pencil Jan 10/11 and we’ll confirm in Dec)
- Offer a short self-serve eval pack (5k inference credits + a /embed walkthrough doc) so your engineers can run a lightweight test against a sanitized dataset without the infra leads being in the room
- If you prefer, we can run a 20-minute async screen capture demo for anyone who wants a product refresher while they’re in the migration sprint

Camila — looping you in for visibility. Evan — does the above sound reasonable? If yes I’ll send a formal pause note and update HubSpot (DEAL-4821) with a Jan follow-up.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads-up, Dev. Sounds like a reasonable deprioritization on SolidData's side — platform migrations often swallow cycles. Two action items from me:

1) Please log the pause in HubSpot with the reason = "platform migration; key stakeholders unavailable" and set the next outreach touch for 2027-01-10. Tag the record with "nurture:light-touch".
2) Offer the 5k inference credit as you proposed and include a one-pager (no-install eval steps + sample prompts). If Evan accepts, mark has_attachments on the HS note and upload the one-pager to the deal folder.

Also consider a short value-nudge email in mid-November (2 sentences + 1 customer ROI bullet) — nothing heavy, just keep awareness without heavy ops. Don’t schedule new live demos until Evan confirms in Dec.

Thanks — loop me back when HubSpot is updated.

Camila Reyes
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
